recommended_architecture: Use probabilistic turn-level or small-window candidate harvesting without deterministic relevance gating.
Have the model select stable span IDs only; deterministic code retrieves exact excerpts instead of asking the model to copy them.
Preserve all harvested candidates in the ledger before any semantic fan-in.
Use a separate fresh-context probabilistic synthesis step for position ownership and thread trajectory over the ordered candidate ledger.
Classify atomic constraint source strength in a narrow second semantic step rather than during broad harvesting.
Evaluate the redesigned stages independently before composing a handoff.
